statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation
The evaluation is for suspected paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The purpose is to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm changes
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was due to lack of required precertification or prior authorization
